expectations.evidence: Uses animate.enter="item-enter" on <li> element in StaggeredListItemComponent template.
Uses animate.leave="item-leave" on <li> element in StaggeredListItemComponent template.
Defines @keyframes item-fade-slide-in (enter: opacity 0->1, translateY 16px->0) and @keyframes item-fade-slide-out (leave: opacity 1->0, translateY 0->16px).
Uses [style.animation-delay]="staggerDelay()" with index * 60ms, capped at index 9 (540ms max).
Uses @for (item of items(); track item.id; let i = $index) in parent template.
